comparison: Perfect agreement on motivation claims (C1, C2, C3, C10, C11). Both evaluations find these claims about DNN successes and limitations well-supported, establishing the study's rationale.
Perfect agreement on ablation study results (C56, C57, C58). Both evaluations accept the comparative findings showing grid cell code superiority over alternative embedding schemes.
